# Hello Interview

> Hello Interview is a comprehensive interview preparation platform offering guided practice, mock interviews, and expert coaching from FAANG engineers to help candidates master system design, low-level design, behavioral interviews, and coding.

Hello Interview provides interactive courses, real interview questions, and personalized feedback from experienced coaches at top tech companies like Meta, Amazon, and Google. The platform combines structured learning with hands-on practice to prepare candidates for technical and behavioral interviews.

## Key Topics

- System Design
- Low Level Design
- FAANG Interviews
- Mock Interviews
- Behavioral Interview
- Guided Practice
- Expert Coaches
- Interview Preparation
- Machine Learning System Design
- Data Structures and Algorithms

- Premium Subscription
- Real Interview Questions
- Meta
- Amazon

## Core Platform

- [Hello Interview](https://www.hellointerview.com): Homepage for Hello Interview interview prep platform with mock interviews and coaching.
- [Hello Interview Premium](https://www.hellointerview.com/premium): Hello Interview Premium subscription with system design, practice problems, and real interview questions.
- [Pricing](https://www.hellointerview.com/pricing): Pricing page for Hello Interview Premium and mock interview plans.

## Guided Practice & Mock Interviews

- [Guided Practice](https://www.hellointerview.com/practice/overview): Interactive guided practice for system design with personalized feedback from FAANG interviewers.
- [System Design Guided Practice](https://www.hellointerview.com/practice): System design practice with step-by-step guidance for Twitter, Uber, and more.

## Learning Courses

- [System Design in a Hurry](https://www.hellointerview.com/learn/system-design): System design learning guide for FAANG interviews built by hiring managers.
- [System Design in a Hurry - Introduction](https://www.hellointerview.com/learn/system-design/in-a-hurry/introduction): System design course essentials built by FAANG hiring managers and staff engineers.
- [Low Level Design in a Hurry](https://www.hellointerview.com/learn/low-level-design): Low level design course covering OOP and design patterns for FAANG interviews.
- [Low Level Design in a Hurry - Introduction](https://www.hellointerview.com/learn/low-level-design/in-a-hurry/introduction): Low level design course covering OOP design and interview patterns from FAANG experts.
- [Machine Learning System Design in a Hurry](https://www.hellointerview.com/learn/ml-system-design): ML system design course essentials for FAANG machine learning engineer interviews.
- [Data Structures and Algorithms](https://www.hellointerview.com/learn/code): DSA learning guide with interactive visualizations and algorithm patterns.
- [Behavioral Interview Course](https://www.hellointerview.com/learn/behavioral): Behavioral interview course by Meta hiring expert covering soft skills and culture fit.
- [Why the Behavioral Interview Matters](https://www.hellointerview.com/learn/behavioral/course/why-the-behavioral-matters): Behavioral interview guide by former Meta hiring committee chair with 1,000+ interviews.
